name: Muradin Bronzebeard's Silver Coin
description: May the Holy Light protect us on our expedition to the frozen north.

name: Aegwynn's Silver Coin
description: I really wish you mages would get your heads out from inside your own... books.

name: Alleria's Silver Coin
description: May my sisters realize their full potential, the name Windrunner known as a result of their deeds.

name: Antonidas' Silver Coin
description: Grant me the strength to accept the things that I cannot change, the courage to change the things I can, and the wisdom to know the difference.

name: Arcanist Doan's Silver Coin
description: Oh, why won't you notice me? Abbendis, I would follow you anywhere. I wish you would notice me...

name: Fandral Staghelm's Silver Coin
description: I pray that when the time comes, I will have the strength to thwart the forces beyond the gate.

name: High Tinker Mekkatorque's Silver Coin
description: How does this fountain even work? I wonder if I could make one.

name: Khadgar's Silver Coin
description: Turalyon and Alleria, wherever you are, may you be well.

name: King Terenas Menethil's Silver Coin
description: May my son Arthas always act in the best interest of his people.

name: Maiev Shadowsong's Silver Coin
description: Where's Illidan?

name: Medivh's Silver Coin
description: <You sense the ringing of three tones in your head, the third barely audible under the others' din.>

name: Prince Magni Bronzebeard's Silver Coin
description: I hope that my father and brothers outlive me. I'll not make much of a king.

name: Anduin Wrynn's Gold Coin
description: I wish I would grow up, it feels like I've been 10 for years.

name: Uther Lightbringer's Gold Coin
description: Young Arthas must learn patience to temper his power. I will pray that he one day learns how to lead with care rather than force.

name: Arthas' Gold Coin
description: Already, I've a kingdom in my prospects, a land to rule. What to ask for? Perhaps a frozen scone...

name: Arugal's Gold Coin
description: I wish someday to retire to my own tidy little estate, with a bunch of pet dogs to keep me company.

name: Brann Bronzebeard's Gold Coin
description: Brann Bronzebeard was here.

name: Kel'Thuzad's Gold Coin
description: Sometimes... I wish someone would come along and just give me a big, long hug.

name: Lady Jaina Proudmoore's Gold Coin
description: Arthas, my love, please come back to me.

name: Lady Katrana Prestor's Gold Coin
description: Listen, little wishing fountain. You'll give me all your power if you know what's good for you.

name: Sylvanas Windrunner's Gold Coin
description: I hope my sisters and I can grow up and get married together. This coin appears to be very old.

name: Tirion Fordring's Gold Coin
description: It is my wish that my dear Taelan will grow strong enough to defend the people he cares for.

name: Archimonde's Gold Coin
description: I wish to know how you survived my wrath, little fountain.

name: Valdrus Blackthorne's Gold Coin
description: Explain my dreams, little fountain. Why must I always be viewing my kin from above and moving them like pawns?

name: Umbrinoth's Gold Coin
description: It seems my moonlighting days as a postal worker are coming to an end.

name: Thrall's Gold Coin
description: Grom, may you rest well, old friend.

name: Sonya Darkhallow's Gold Coin
description: This doesn't make sense. Why am I putting a coin in a fountain?

name: Zarla Ober's Gold Coin
description: The amount of coins shining in the pool. Maybe no one will notice if I take just one.

name: A Footman's Copper Coin
description: Wish I had that cousin of mine's duty to do nothing more than lug wood around carelessly...

name: Vargoth's Copper Coin
description: I wish Captain Sanders would hurry up with my shipment of wine.

name: Ansirem's Copper Coin
description: I wish for happiness and acceptance for my daughter. She feels so out of place here...

name: Attumen's Copper Coin
description: Can I have a more comfortable saddle? My hindquarters ache.

name: Danath's Copper Coin
description: I hope a troll dies, right... NOW.

name: Elling Trias' Copper Coin
description: Being a rogue is hard work. Someday I hope to pursue my life's one true passion...

name: Falstad Wildhammer's Copper Coin
description: I hope I end up in another book eventually.

name: Inigo's Copper Coin
description: I wish I had my father back...

name: Landro Longshot's Copper Coin
description: I wish I'd kept that coin...

name: Squire Rowan's Copper Coin
description: I wish people would stop knocking my toys off the shelf.

name: Rath'mael's Copper Coin
description: I could have used this copper for something productive. Perhaps something with string and a machine.

name: Mason's Copper Coin
description: It's not even magical here.

name: Ofalo's Copper Coin
description: How does a tavern run out of ale!

name: Sair's Copper Coin
description: I miss my sword and shield. I feel so naked without my sword and shield.

name: Rhonin's Gold Coin
description: Here you go, Nozdormu. What was I supposed to do after this?

name: Elaadrin Evengale's Silver Coin
description: How do I prove they copied us with this fountain?

name: Tender Strider Meat
description: Kyle would delight in taking a bite out of this succulent treat!

name: Titan Relic
description: Fragmented remnants of the construct, refracting light like a kaleidoscope.

description: Fragmented remnants of the construct, refracting light like a kaleidoscope.

description: An old key.
